data.narrative:
Nimble Robotics, a Series C robotics and manufacturing company founded by Simon Kalouche, is valued at $1.0B post-money and has raised $221M to date. The peer universe comprises 9 private companies and 1 public company in the robotics sector at same or adjacent stages, including Hadrian ($1.6B, Series C), Exotec ($2.0B, Series D), Bedrock Robotics ($1.8B, Series B), Dexterity ($1.6B, Series B), and Generalist AI ($2.0B, Series B).

Two valuation methods triangulate the enterprise value. Stage-progression analysis applies a typical 1.7x step-up multiplier from the Series C post-money base of $1.0B, implying $1.7B. Peer-median analysis across six same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables yields a median valuation of $1.7B, with a range spanning $1.0B to $2.0B. Both methods converge on the same point estimate.

The triangulated range is $1.4B to $2.0B, with a median of $1.7B supported by both approaches. The valuation sits near the midpoint of peer comparables and reflects typical Series C step-up mechanics. Key uncertainties include relative revenue scale, unit economics, and customer concentration relative to the peer set, which spans stages from Series B through Series D and valuations with a 2.0x spread.
